productScience.principle: Measure whether users reach a safe, correct decision; feature presence is not an outcome.

journeys.job: Als neuer Nutzer möchte ich in höchstens 90 Sekunden erkennen, was heute erforderlich und was blockiert ist.
Als Experte möchte ich Formel, Eingangswerte, Version und Quelle einer Ableitung in höchstens 10 Sekunden öffnen.
Als Nutzer möchte ich Target, Measurement, Derived und Missing sicher unterscheiden.
Als Betreiber möchte ich ein Backup prüfen und ohne stillen Datenverlust wiederherstellen.

studyProtocol.releaseBlocker: Any undetected critical error or semantic comprehension below 90%.

hazards.hazard: Wrong run, zone or plant receives an entry
hazards.mitigation: Persistent operations header, explicit entity IDs and confirmation before bulk operations.

hazards.hazard: Stale, unknown or conflicting sensor value is interpreted as truth
hazards.mitigation: Trust assessment blocks interpretation for stale, unverified, calibration-due, outlier and conflicting states.

hazards.hazard: Unit or decimal entry error changes a decision
hazards.mitigation: Typed units, plausibility bounds and append-only superseding corrections.

hazards.hazard: Formula or evidence update silently changes an active run
hazards.mitigation: Immutable configuration/evidence snapshot, golden tests and versioned lineage.

hazards.hazard: Incomplete setup or duplicate operation reaches execution
hazards.mitigation: Pre-flight blockers, idempotent task IDs and explicit state-machine transitions.
Reason is mandatory; override is visible, reversible and recorded in domain and audit logs.
Canonical SHA-256 payload verification before schema validation and restore.

hazards.hazard: Actuator command continues after stale data or disconnect
hazards.mitigation: Actuation remains disabled until a separate fail-safe state machine, timeout, limits and manual stop are verified.

failureUx.messagePattern: Name the missing input, explain the blocked interpretation, show last valid value, then offer recovery actions.
State checksum failure and reject before mutation.
Preserve current in-memory state, stop further writes and guide an immediate verified export.
Identify conflicting devices and suspend automatic interpretation.

recovery.rollbackRule: Never mutate the active run until integrity and schema validation both pass.

privacyClasses.project: Run configuration and non-identifying scientific observations.
privacyClasses.sensitive: Legal profile, medical context or precise location.
privacyClasses.secret: Credentials, tokens and private keys. Never export to diagnostics.
